capabilities: Capture quick notes with Enter to save
Show and add todos from the home page
Record a daily log and weekly check-in
Generate an AI review of the last 7 days
Park unfinished drafts and view a capture timeline
extras: Installed manually by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from Releases into the plugin folder; README is in Chinese with an English section.
problem: Obsidian opens to a file list, with no single place to capture a thought, see open todos and review the day's record.
summary: Home page dashboard that gathers quick notes, todos, daily logs, AI weekly reviews and drafts, over an animated bamboo background.
